summary: The agent failed the verifier due to incorrect Ending Balance formulas that self-referenced empty cells (e.g., =B11+C11-D11 instead of =B11+C10-D10), despite existing documentation warning against this exact anti-pattern. The task was a capitalized project cost rollforward - a variant similar to commission assets but with specific data handling (revision filtering, CSV overrides, vendor sorting). Adding this as a documented variant with its specific data patterns will help future agents recognize the rollforward pattern applies and avoid the formula trap.
